summary.headline: Anlon Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin fell to ~17% (PAT ₹8.28 cr) on raw-material spikes and Remember India consolidation; management targets 25-27% for FY27.
summary.overview: Consolidated Q1 FY27 total income was ₹87.62 cr versus ₹33.31 cr in Q1 FY26, with EBITDA of ₹15.65 cr (vs ₹6.26 cr) and PAT of ₹8.28 cr (vs ₹3.55 cr). EBITDA margin moderated to about 17%, which management attributed to a sharp rise in solvent and petrochemical raw-material prices after the geopolitical conflict and to operating costs of the newly acquired Remember India Health links being consolidated. The company completed the 63.98% acquisition of Remember India on 8 May 2026, has acquired Apiqo Organics and Bizotic Lifesciences, and is moving into finished dosage formulations. Management reiterated FY27 revenue guidance of ₹350-400 cr and a ~30% three-year revenue CAGR, but gave limited quantitative detail on Remember India.

financial_highlights.change: moderated; management earlier guided ~24-25% floor for Q1

financial_highlights.metric: Revenue contribution, Q1 FY27 - Anlon standalone
financial_highlights.change: management cited standalone sales of ₹30 cr vs ₹33 cr in analyst question

segments.name: Anlon Healthcare (standalone)
segments.commentary: Q1 revenue ~₹30-32 cr, down from ₹33 cr YoY per analyst; management says it is at peak utilisation and expects FY27 standalone revenue of ~₹180 cr. Production cycles of 30-45 days mean some output lands in Q2.

segments.name: Apiqo Organics (68% stake, moving to 100%)
segments.commentary: Q1 revenue ~₹45 cr, described as the most profitable unit; FY27 revenue expected ₹120-150 cr. Business is fully booked in industrial and fine chemicals; share-swap to make it a 100% subsidiary to complete by end-Q2.

segments.name: Bizotic Lifesciences (57% stake, moving to 100%)
segments.commentary: Q1 revenue ~₹12 cr; FY27 expected ~₹60 cr. Management says it is profitable and that committed partner business exists; share-swap to 100% also targeted by end-Q2.

segments.name: Remember India Health links (63.98%)
segments.commentary: Finished dosage formulations (tablets, capsules, ointments) with access to 30+ dossiers; in investment and turnaround phase. No revenue assumed for FY27 until at least Q4 FY27; WHO-PQ approval expected by end-CY2026. Margin expected above 25%.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue guidance of ₹350-400 cr reiterated; management said H1 comparison is the right lens, and the guidance range was re-confirmed as ₹380-400 cr in one answer.
EBITDA margin: ~17% in Q1; management expects margins to improve from Q2 (said 'better than the first quarter') and target 25-27% for FY27 on consolidated basis; earlier comment of 22-25% in H1.
Gross margin expected to hold at 40-45%.
FY28 revenue indicated at ~₹700 cr if Anlon-site expansion (~₹130 cr capex, ~1,200 MT additional) is commissioned on schedule by Q1 FY28; management flagged possible delays from statutory approvals.

Working capital: receivable days expected to fall toward 60-70 days over time (current ~130-135 days vs 90-day terms); management expects positive operating cash flow in FY27, 'lower but positive'. Management also said H1 operating cash flow positive is targeted before year-end.
Biologics subsidiary (Anlon Biologics) revenue expected from Q4 FY28; Anlon Medicare from Q2 FY28; Remember India peak revenue/EBITDA to be detailed in Q2 call.
capex_capacity: Installed capacity after three acquisitions stated at ~1,400-1,600 MT per annum; management clarified Anlon standalone is ~400 MT and is at peak.
Anlon-site expansion: ~₹130 cr capex adding ~1,200 MT (standalone to ~1,600 MT); commissioning targeted by Q1 FY28 subject to statutory approvals.
Funding: ~₹70 cr debt at ~8.5-8.6% interest; balance from internal accruals.
Eight new cleanrooms planned at the new facility to run eight APIs in parallel; initial planning assumes 50-60% utilisation.
Bizotic and Apiqo utilisation can rise gradually from ~65% toward higher levels; no 65-to-85% jump expected within this year.
Anlon Biologics (peptides, biosimilars) construction to begin within ~2 months; in-house peptide manufacturing targeted by FY28.
demand_pricing: Raw material prices: management said solvent/methanol-linked inputs rose 2-3x since pre-war (methanol cited at ₹22 to ₹58-60/kg); not yet normalised. Around 40% of API manufacturing cost is solvents and petroleum-linked inputs.

Price pass-through: price increases on finished products have been initiated and customers have agreed; management expects this to reflect over the next one to two quarters, but earlier orders at old prices weighed on Q1.
Customer base is concentrated: 10-15 B2B customers, which limits ability to reprice frequently.
Fine/specialty chemicals (Apiqo): fully booked, described as 'overbooked'; management estimates ₹120-150 cr contribution in FY27.
CDMO: expected commercial supply of first molecule by Q3 and others by Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28; process validations ongoing.
Seven new APIs/DMFs planned for filing within FY27; compilation under way.
